title: Where the rule and the posted comment disagree
compared: Whether a decision rule that names a different class than the posted comment can flag the comments worth a second look: how often the rule is right where the two differ and where they agree.
sample: The 128 public jobs of the frozen confirmation run.

rows.rule: three orders and the environment question

verdict: With the three-order rule the classes differ on 49% of the jobs, and there the rule is right only a little less often (68% against 80%); the two-question rule gives nearly the same. A useful flag had to mark 15 to 40% of the jobs with a gap of at least 20 points. Dropped.
